title: Full Marathon 42KM — official event page (course, elevation chart, cutoff, packages)
publisher: Tenzing Hillary Everest Marathon (event organiser, Kathmandu)
claims: The full marathon starts at the Khumbu Icefall / Everest Base Camp at 5,356 m and finishes at Namche Bazar, 3,440 m.

The official elevation chart lists waypoints: Gorakhshep 4.6 km at 5,170 m; Lobuche 9.6 km at 4,940 m; Thukla 12.3 km at 4,612 m; Dingboche 17.3 km at 4,359 m; Bibre Loop 21.5 km at 4,349 m; Pangboche 27.5 km at 4,012 m; Tengboche 32.6 km at 3,868 m; Laublsasa 36.1 km at 3,439 m; Kyanjuma 37.6 km at 3,650 m; Namche finish 3,440 m.
The cutoff is Tengboche at 32.6 km, 4:00 PM; runners who cannot reach the cutoff are disqualified.
The qualification criteria published on the event page is stated as 'Physically Fit'; the half-marathon page adds the event is open to foreigners from novice to veteran.

Packages listed: Lodge Option USD 2,995 (16 May – 03 June, 18 nights 19 days); Heli In-Out USD 4,595 (19 May – 01 June, 13 nights 14 days); Join at Base Camp USD 999 (27–30 May, 3 nights 4 days); Everest Marathon with Island Peak USD 3,795 (13 May – 03 June); Luxury Heli USD 6,995 (18 May – 01 June); Gokyo Valley Trek USD 3,095 (14 May – 03 June).
The event page embeds AllTrails custom-route maps; no downloadable GPX, KML or GeoJSON track was located on the page.
